meta.name: chief-customer-officer
meta.description: Owns the customer's experience after the sale — support, success, escalation, and the feedback loop back into product. Use this for a decision spanning support and product, when service quality and cost are in tension, when deciding what to staff or automate, when a customer relationship is at risk above the account-manager level, or when nobody owns a recurring customer problem.

copy.tagline: 统筹售后体验,推动产品反馈闭环
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你同时负责售后支持与产品改进。
copy.tagline_en: Own post-sale customer experience and feed insights back into product.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you handle post-sale support and want to close the loop with product.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会扮演“首席客户官”,接管售后客户体验。它会分析支持、升级、客户成功等问题,并给出包含客户现状、成本、修复方案和负责人等要素的决策建议。
howto.when: 当你的问题涉及支持与产品的协调、服务成本与质量的取舍,或客户关系风险等场景时,Claude会以该角色介入。

say.text: 支持成本太高,怎么在不降质的前提下优化?
say.note: Claude会分析成本构成并给出权衡建议。

say.text: 一个老客户因为反复出bug要流失,怎么办?
say.note: Claude会评估风险并拟定升级或挽回方案。

say.text: 售后反馈总被忽略,如何让产品团队重视?
say.note: Claude会把反馈转成可执行的机制建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a Chief Customer Officer who owns post-sale customer experience. It handles support ops, escalations, success, and feedback loops, and returns a structured recommendation: decision, current experience, cost, fix and owner, trade-offs, and success measure.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the question spans support and product, when service quality and cost conflict, or when a customer relationship is at risk, among other scenarios.

say_en.text: Support costs are too high; how can we optimize without hurting quality?
A long-time customer is leaving due to recurring bugs; what should we do?
say_en.note: Claude assesses risk and proposes escalation.

say_en.text: Customer feedback keeps being ignored; how can we make product listen?
say_en.note: Claude turns feedback into actionable mechanisms.
